_: What location art the release has, read from its SWFs, so that a location's references can be checked without them (tools/location_art.py lint, tools/test_location_art.py). libraries: name -> sha (16 hex of client/base.txt's), stage (the root draws a picture: a painted library, whose picture also stands in for any name it does not export), exports (the names <sprite type=lib>, <bgdecoration> and <background> may use). sprites: ext ids (locations/libs/sprite/<id>.swf), animated: their frame counts above 1, backgrounds: ext backgrounds, tracks: bgsound names.
